EVALUATE
VAR Base =
    SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
        'Period'[Quarter 445],
        'Product'[LT1.4 - Sub-Category],
        FILTER(ALL('Ship From'[Country]), 'Ship From'[Country] = "Colombia"),
        FILTER(ALL('Period'), 'Period'[Day 445] <= "May 26 2026" && 'Period'[Year 445] = "2026"),
        "Unit Cases YTD", [Unit Cases AC YTD]
    )
VAR Ranked =
    ADDCOLUMNS(
        Base,
        "Rank",
        RANKX(
            FILTER(Base, EARLIER('Period'[Quarter 445]) = 'Period'[Quarter 445]),
            [Unit Cases YTD],
            ,
            DESC,
            DENSE
        )
    )
VAR Top10 =
    FILTER(Ranked, [Rank] <= 10)
RETURN
Top10
